items.description: Quantification is a prominent machine learning task that has received an  increasing amount of attention in the last years. The objective is to predict the  class distribution of a data sample. This package is a collection of machine learning  algorithms for class distribution estimation. This package include algorithms from different paradigms of quantification. These methods are described in the paper:  A. Maletzke, W. Hassan, D. dos Reis, and G. Batista. The importance of the test set  size in quantification assessment. In Proceedings of the Twenty-Ninth International  Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence, IJCAI20, pages 2640–2646, 2020. <doi:10.24963/ijcai.2020/366>.
